transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. It's really nice to meet you too. Thank you so much for fitting me in. 

Um, well, I hope I'm not taking up your time for something silly, but... what made me finally decide to come in is that for the past few weeks, my eating has just been a little off. It's nothing drastic, I promise. It's just that I'll sort of skip breakfast and lunch without really meaning to. And then I end up just picking at dinner, which I feel awful about because my wife cooks for us and I really don't want to seem ungrateful to her. 

But, um, I guess I've noticed my jeans are starting to feel a bit loose lately because of it. Is that the kind of thing I should be mentioning here? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you been feeling less hungry than usual?

Yeah, exactly. Um, like I was just saying, the appetite just really isn't there right now. I'm definitely not trying to starve myself or anything, I promise. I just don't seem to feel that normal urge to eat during the day, so the time just sort of slips by without me noticing. 

I hope I explained that okay before. Does that answer what you were asking?
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Um, well... I really don't want to sound like I'm complaining, because I know I have a lot to be thankful for. But, um, if I'm being completely honest, I suppose I have been feeling a little down. It's nothing too serious, I promise! It's just that... most days lately, I wake up with this sort of heavy, flat feeling. 

It's a bit hard to explain, but it just feels like the apartment is too quiet. And normally I'd just pick up my guitar to snap out of a funk, but lately even doing that doesn't really lift me. 

I hope I'm not making too big a deal out of it. Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions right.
Did something stressful happen in your life shortly before your appetite and mood started to change?

Um, let me think about that... honestly, no. Not really. Things have been pretty quiet and normal, actually. 

I mean, I'm not working right now, but we're managing fine, so it's not like that's a sudden new stress or anything. My wife is wonderful, and... yeah, I really can't think of anything bad that happened to set this off. 

I'm sorry, I know it would probably be a lot more helpful for you if I had a clear reason for why I've been feeling this way. Is it okay that it just sort of happened out of nowhere? I hope I'm not making your job harder by not having a better answer for you.
Have you been feeling this down nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Um, well, yeah, I guess it has been a little while now. I really don't want to make it sound worse than it is, because like I said, it's just a mild funk, you know? But, um, if I'm tracking the days right, this low stretch has probably been going on for about three weeks. 

It sort of started right around the time my wife settled into her new full-time work schedule. I'm really proud of her, and I definitely don't want to sound like I'm complaining about her working! It's just... I guess that's when I started noticing this feeling more. 

I hope three weeks isn't too long to have let this go before talking to someone. Am I giving you the right kind of timeline? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Um, well... not exactly? I mean, I really don't want you to think I'm just sitting around doing nothing all day, I promise I'm not! 

Like I mentioned with my guitar earlier, I still definitely *want* to play it, and I still care about my hobbies. It's just... maybe I don't get that same big rush of enjoyment out of it right this second. But I still do things! I still really look forward to making dinner for my wife when she gets home, and we always watch our shows together in the evening. I definitely still enjoy that. 

So I wouldn't say I've lost interest in the things I love, I don't think. Just maybe... I'm going through the motions a little bit more than usual? I hope that answers your question okay. I just don't want to sound like I've completely given up on everything, you know? Does that make sense?
Have you been worrying a lot lately?

Oh, um, no, actually. I don't think I have been. 

I mean, I try really hard not to let myself get stressed out, you know? Just the normal day-to-day stuff, like making sure the house is nice for my wife when she gets home. But not, like, *worrying* worrying. I definitely don't want you to think I'm just sitting around agonizing over things all day, because I promise I'm not. 

I hope that's a good thing? Like, I hope it's okay that I don't have a lot of anxiety to report. I just want to make sure I'm answering you the right way.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?

Um, well, I am definitely still sleeping! I don't want you to think I'm up all night or anything like that. I usually get to bed at a reasonable hour. 

It's just... maybe it's been a little broken up lately? Like, I'll wake up around four or five in the morning, and my brain will just sort of start going. I'll think about, you know, regular stuff, like bills we need to pay, or maybe some of those music tracks I've been meaning to finish. And then I just can't quite get back to sleep, so I end up feeling a little tired before the day really gets going. 

But I am getting sleep, I promise! It's just a little choppy right now. Is that... is that normal for this kind of thing? I hope I'm not making a big deal out of nothing.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I don't want to sound like I'm just dragging my feet all day, because I'm definitely not! 

Like I said, I still get up and make sure things are taken care of around the house. I might be a little sluggish in the mornings sometimes, especially if I woke up early like I mentioned, but I push through it. I definitely don't just lay around. I try to stay as active as I can, you know? 

So, I wouldn't say I'm unusually tired. Just... maybe normal tired? Like anyone would be? I hope that makes sense. I'm trying to be as helpful as I can with these answers!
Have you been feeling worthless or blaming yourself a lot lately?

Oh, um... no, I wouldn't say that. I definitely don't feel worthless. 

I mean, sure, since I'm not working right now, I try to make sure I'm pulling my weight at home, like I said. Sometimes I might feel a little bad if I don't get the dishes done before my wife gets back, but I don't, like, beat myself up over it or think I'm a terrible person. I know I'm still contributing, you know? 

I really don't want you to think I have this awful self-esteem or that I'm just sitting around hating myself, because I'm absolutely not. I try to stay really positive. Is that... does that sound like a healthy way to look at it? I hope I'm giving you the right kind of information.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?

Um, well... I wouldn't call it trouble, exactly. I mean, my brain is definitely still working fine! I don't want it to sound like I can't focus at all or that I'm just staring at the wall. 

It's just... maybe sometimes it takes me a little longer to get through things? Like, if I'm trying to work on some code for a project, or if I'm arranging one of my songs, I might find myself, you know, rereading the same line a few times. Or I'll replay the same eight bars of music over and over, and I just can't quite make up my mind on what to do with it next. 

But I always get there eventually! It's just a little bit of a mental block sometimes, which I think happens to everyone, right? I mean, creative stuff can be tricky like that. I hope that's the kind of example you were looking for... does that make sense?
Have you lost weight lately?

Um, well, I guess I might have lost a little bit of weight? But it's nothing crazy, I promise! I definitely don't want you to think I'm starving myself or anything like that. 

It's just... I guess over the last few weeks, my eating has been a little, um, off. Like, I'll be so busy trying to figure out a song or working on the house that I'll just sort of forget breakfast and lunch. I don't mean to! And then by dinner, even when my wife makes something really nice, I just kind of pick at it. 

I only really noticed because my jeans are starting to feel a little loose, you know? But I'm still eating! Just maybe not quite as much as usual. I'm sure it's just a phase, right? I hope that doesn't sound too concerning... I'm really trying to make sure I take care of myself. Is that the kind of thing you need to know?
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual lately?

Um, I mean... maybe just a little? But I definitely don't want you to picture me, like, moving in slow motion or anything like that. I'm still totally capable! 

It's just... I guess lately, everything feels a little slower right now. Like, I'll sit down to work on something, and I'll have my laptop open, but I might just sit there for ages before I even move my hands to type or, you know, plug in the keyboard. It's almost like a tiny delay between thinking about doing it and actually doing it? 

But I'm not, like, speaking super slow or anything right now, am I? I really hope I'm answering this the right way for you... I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need to know.
